output.answer: As of November 2026, Saks (Saks Fifth Avenue) is owned by Exemplar Luxury Group (ELG) — the luxury collective, formerly called Saks Global, that also owns Neiman Marcus and Bergdorf Goodman. Saks Global filed for Chapter 11 bankruptcy in January 2026 and emerged on June 26, 2026 under new ownership, rebranding as Exemplar Luxury Group with roughly 75% of its debt erased. Its new controlling owners are its former bondholders, the investment firms Pentwater Capital Management and Bracebridge Capital, which each hold two seats on ELG's seven-person board. Historically, Saks Fifth Avenue had been owned by Hudson's Bay Company since 2013 and was spun into Saks Global in 2024; HBC itself filed for bankruptcy in June 2025.
caveats: "Saks" is ambiguous: if the question means Saks Global itself rather than the Saks Fifth Avenue banner, then Saks Global no longer exists as a brand — the entity rebranded as Exemplar Luxury Group when it exited Chapter 11 in June 2026.

ELG is privately held under new ownership; its precise equity split among Pentwater, Bracebridge and other capital partners is not disclosed — the public record shows board representation (two of seven seats each), not exact ownership percentages.
If "Saks" refers to Saks Off 5th, that off-price chain was not part of Saks Global and was shuttered; it is a separate lineage.
